name: Grilled chicken at the camp
summary: Grilled chicken is the supper at the summit camp on the two-day trek, eaten with steamed sticky rice and the hosts’ corn and banana wine.
origin: The summit camp, on the trek from bản Pù Luông toward bản Báng. Source: VietNamNet, 16 Nov 2025.
howToEat: At the camp supper, after an arrival at about 15:30.
where: The summit camp on the two-day trek.
seoTitle: Grilled chicken at the Pu Luong summit camp
seoDescription: Gà nướng is the summit-camp supper on the Pù Luông trek, with xôi đồ, corn wine, and banana wine.
